headline: Minto Bridge and Rajpur Road underpasses shut after overnight rain; traffic diverted via ITO and Civil Lines inner roads.
AIIMS Ring Road underpass waterlogged; ambulances delayed at Safdarjung and AIIMS gates during evening peak.
Punjabi Bagh Club Road and Raja Garden on Ring Road see knee-deep flooding; west Delhi commute hit.
Zakhira underpass closed for six hours; Pragati Maidan tunnel ramps also under water after cloudburst.
Pul Prahladpur underpass submerged again; Chirag Delhi flyover and Okhla underpass at Modi Mill also flagged.
Ashram Chowk and Sarai Kale Khan back up for hours as Ring Road drains overflow.
MG Road and IFFCO Chowk in Gurugram inundated; office traffic crawled toward Dhaula Kuan.
Hero Honda Chowk and Narsinghpur on NH-48 under water; Gurugram advisory asks offices to allow work from home.
Noida Sector 18 market and Mahamaya Flyover underpass flooded; DND approach slow from Mayur Vihar.
Laxmi Nagar and Anand Vihar report waterlogging on Vikas Marg; LNJP-bound traffic advised to use ITO.
Mohan Nagar and Loni roads under water in Ghaziabad; Mukarba Chowk backs up to Azadpur on the Delhi side.
Badkhal Mor underpass and Bata Chowk flooded in Faridabad; NH-19 traffic diverted through service lanes.
Shastri Park and Seelampur report knee-deep water; Wazirabad Road closed to light vehicles.
Mahipalpur and Kapashera Border flooded on the airport approach; Dwarka Sector 8 underpass shut.
